$comment: Places where a zh/fa translation is allowed to carry different figures from the English source, each with the reason. Read by scripts/test-translations.mjs; `where` is the location the test prints ('*' matches anything). Structure, placeholders and identifiers can never be allowed here — only numbers.

DECISIONS.md §1: Persian dates are numeric and never use month names, so the English 'Customs rules from May 1' can only be written with its year: ۲۰۲۵/۰۵/۰۱, the year of the Spot.uz article it cites (date 2025-04-23).
